0022600164.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-2, 2-1 at home, on a three-game winning streak) host the Sacramento Kings (0-5, 0-2 at home, on a five-game losing streak) in the Mavericks' seventh game of the season. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, and in 2025-26 the Mavericks lost the series 1-2, including a 130-121 loss in Dallas on February 26, 2026.
